headline: A new internal trinification H27, distinct from the rejected Pass369 Weyl H27, has center exactly Z(E6). In E6 >= (SU3^3)/DeltaZ3 take X_int=(X,X,I), Z_int=(Z^2,Z,I); with ZX=omegaXZ their commutator is (omega^2,omega,1), which acts as scalar omega on all three nonets of the E6 27. The physical external-A2 H27 has center the measured FI/Qpsi Z3. The kernel of (E6 x SU3_ext)->E8 identifies these two centers, so the commuting H27 factors form their central product of order 243, exponent 3: the two-qutrit Pauli group 3_+^(1+4).

trinification.subgroup: (SU3_1 x SU3_2 x SU3_3)/Delta Z3 <= E6

hostile_control_resolution: The Pass369 regular Weyl H27 still cannot glue because its center is not Z(E6). The trinification H27 constructed here is a different subgroup specifically engineered and checked to have commutator center Z(E6).
boundary: Exact finite subgroup/representation theorem. It does not prove a D/F-flat heterotic vacuum, observed family identification, Standard Model dynamics, or photonic implementation.
